posts.text: it was embarrassing and tacky when biden put his face on the us passport. it’s embarrassing and tacky when trump does it.

gulf unity is cracking.
the gcc could be next.
what held the region together
isn’t holding anymore.
@gzeromedia

Video

uae is withdrawing from opec. 
what looks like energy politics is something deeper.
a fight over the region’s future.
@gzeromedia

Video
united arab emirates leaves opec. abu dhabi asserting itself now that dubai safe haven status is in doubt.

allies didn’t sign up for this war.
now they’re paying for it.
expect more hedging
and less trust in the united states.
@gzeromedia

Video

a thousand ships backed up.
months to clear.
refineries damaged across the region.
this isn’t a quick fix even with a deal.
@gzeromedia

reflecting on the noise and disinformation of this moment, with @zacharykarabell 

it induces anger. concern. stress. and addiction. 

and it’s a mechanism for control

the institutions you think are strong might not stand.
the leaders you think will stand up for something might not.

if blockade is still in place, don’t see how it’s not issue number one for xi in his summit with trump.

domestic political response to whcd shooter has been more responsible/less unhinged and wildly partisan than we’ve seen with recent political violence.

don’t want to jinx it and easy to find exceptions, but i’ll take good news wherever we can find it.
moose wishes you a most happy sunday : )
at least with the falklands there’s an argument. unlike, say, greenland.

trump pulls down kushner/witkoff trip to islamabad. but for the first time no trump ultimatums to iran, no “or else.” 

restarting the war only a losing option for him. the iranians appear to have realized this.
of all the war goals trump has walked back on, the one he’s backed away from fastest is rescuing the people of iran. as expected, they will end up suffering the most.
starting to think president trump’s unilateral withdrawal from the iranian nuclear deal wasn’t well thought through.
